name: Liam
source:
Having no affinity for sports, his favorite pastime is reading comic books brought by his father during his travels abroad. He often finds himself creating awkward moments by giving voice to his thoughts, but this very same habit brought him closer to someone special. Unable to focus for a long period of time, he tries his best at class so he won't have to study at home.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1026845993558532097] Twitter[/url]]
